title: Pure Pendulum Pile
summary: Pure Pendulum Pile combo strategy, unifying the strongest 1-card Pendulum engines in the game: Supreme King Dragons, Dracoslayers, Chronograph Sorcerer, and Odd-Eyes. The deck sets up free pre-Pendulum bodies without consuming a Normal Summon to Link Summon Beyond the Pendulum, searching missing Scales and resolving massive 4-to-5 monster Pendulum Summons that end on Odd-Eyes Vortex Dragon, Ignister Prominence, and Exceed the Pendulum.

summary.title: Starters & Setup
points: Dragon Shrine & Foolish Burial: Send Supreme King Dragon Darkwurm to the GY, which immediately revives itself and searches Supreme King Gate Zero.
Chronograph Sorcerer: Destroys itself in the Pendulum Zone to Special Summon Timegazer Magician directly from the hand or Deck.
Odd-Eyes Revolution Dragon: Discards itself to search any Level 8 or lower Dragon Pendulum, primarily Supreme King Dragon Darkwurm.
Wings of Light: Quick-Play searcher for any Supreme King Dragon or Supreme King Gate Pendulum monster.
Supreme King Gate Magician: Places a Supreme King Gate in the scale, sends a Dragon from the Extra Deck to GY to summon itself, and searches Wings of Light.

summary.title: Opening Play
steps: Activate Dragon Shrine to mill Supreme King Dragon Darkwurm from the Deck to the GY.
Special Summon Supreme King Dragon Darkwurm from the GY and search Supreme King Gate Zero.
Activate Chronograph Sorcerer in the Pendulum Zone, popping itself to Special Summon Timegazer Magician.
Link Summon Beyond the Pendulum using Supreme King Dragon Darkwurm and Timegazer Magician before Pendulum Summoning.
Pay 1200 LP with Beyond the Pendulum to add Astrograph Sorcerer or a missing Scale to your hand.
Set Scales (Scale 0 Supreme King Gate Zero and a high Scale), then Pendulum Summon 3 to 4 monsters including Supreme King Gate Magician and Level 4 monsters.
Overlay Supreme King Gate Magician and Astrograph Sorcerer into Odd-Eyes Absolute Dragon, then link into Exceed the Pendulum to trigger Absolute and summon Odd-Eyes Vortex Dragon.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Odd-Eyes Vortex Dragon: Premier omni-negate boss summoned via Odd-Eyes Absolute Dragon, shuffling a face-up Pendulum into the Deck to negate activations.
Odd-Eyes Absolute Dragon: Rank 7 Xyz bridge that cheats out Odd-Eyes Vortex Dragon whenever it is sent to the GY as Link material.
Ignister Prominence, the Blasting Dracoslayer: Destroys a Pendulum card you control to shuffle any card on the field into the Deck without targeting.
Supreme King Dragon Clear Wing: Destroys all face-up monsters your opponent controls upon Synchro Summon.
Beyond the Pendulum facilitates pre-Pendulum search consistency and link arrows, while Exceed the Pendulum provides monster revival during either turn.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Dragon Shrine: Initiates the 0-Normal-Summon Darkwurm engine to produce bodies before Pendulum Summoning.
Wings of Light: Provides instant access to Gate Magician or Darkwurm.
Pendulum Evolution: Enables an additional Pendulum Summon of face-up Extra Deck monsters and searches high-ATK Pendulums.
Foolish Burial: Redundant one-card starter for milling Darkwurm.

allow.Timegazer Magician: Scale 8 Level 3 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum summoned directly from your hand or Deck by Chronograph Sorcerer's Pendulum Effect—putting a body on the board to make Beyond the Pendulum without using your Normal Summon or Pendulum Summon!
allow.Harmonizing Magician: Scale 8 Level 4 Tuner that Special Summons a Magician from the Deck when Pendulum Summoned.
allow.Double Iris Magician: Scale 8 Level 4 Pendulum that searches Time/Star Pendulumgraph when destroyed by Beyond the Pendulum or Ignister Prominence.
allow.Performapal Skullcrobat Joker: Normal Summon starter that searches Odd-Eyes, Magician, or Performapal Pendulum monsters.
allow.Dragon Shrine: Sends Supreme King Dragon Darkwurm from your Deck to the GY—and Darkwurm immediately revives itself from the GY if you control no monsters and searches Supreme King Gate Zero or Supreme King Gate Magician!
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Supreme King Dragon Darkwurm to the GY for a 0-Normal-Summon starter + search.
allow.Wings of Light: Quick-Play Spell that searches any 'Supreme King Dragon' or 'Supreme King Gate' Pendulum Monster from your Deck, or Special Summons it if you control Z-ARC!
allow.Ignister Prominence, the Blasting Dracos: Level 8 Dragon Synchro that pops a Pendulum Card to shuffle a card on the field into the Deck without targeting.
allow.Majester Paladin, the Ascending Dracosla: Rank 4 Dragon Xyz that searches any Pendulum Monster during the End Phase and Special Summons a Dracoslayer from your Extra Deck.

main: Supreme King Gate Magician

Core Scale 1 Level 7 LIGHT Spellcaster Pendulum: places a 'Supreme King Gate' in your Pendulum Zone, sends a Dragon from Extra Deck to GY to Special Summon itself from hand, and searches Wings of Light on Special Summon!
Supreme King Dragon Darkwurm
Core Scale 5 Level 4 DARK Dragon Pendulum: if you control no monsters, revives itself from GY and searches ANY 'Supreme King Gate' Pendulum Monster on Normal or Special Summon!
Supreme King Dragon Lightwurm

Scale 8 Level 4 LIGHT Dragon Pendulum Tuner: adds a face-up Supreme King Dragon or Supreme King Gate Pendulum from your Extra Deck to your hand on Summon, and immediately Synchro or Xyz Summons a Supreme King Dragon upon resolution!
Supreme King Gate Zero
Scale 0 Level 7 DARK Fiend Pendulum searched by Darkwurm and Gate Magician—allowing you to Pendulum Summon even Level 1–7 monsters!
Astrograph Sorcerer

Limited to 1 in TCG: Scale 1 Level 7 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum that Special Summons itself from hand whenever a card you control is destroyed and adds a copy of a destroyed monster from your Deck to your hand!
Chronograph Sorcerer
Scale 8 Level 6 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum: destroys itself in your Pendulum Zone to Special Summon Timegazer Magician directly from your hand or Deck!
Timegazer Magician
Summoned from the Deck by Chronograph Sorcerer to provide a free Pendulum body on the field before you Pendulum Summon.
Odd-Eyes Revolution Dragon
Scale 12 Dragon Pendulum: discards itself and pays 500 LP to add ANY Level 8 or lower Dragon Pendulum Monster from your Deck to your hand!
Majesty Pegasus, the Dracoslayer
Scale 2 Level 4 Pendulum that searches Ignis Phoenix in the Pendulum Zone and searches a Field Spell when Pendulum Summoned.
Ignis Phoenix, the Dracoslayer
Scale 7 Level 4 Pendulum that Special Summons Majesty Pegasus or Luster Pendulum from your Deck as a Tuner when destroyed by Beyond the Pendulum or Ignister Prominence.
Luster Pendulum, the Dracoslayer
Scale 5 Level 4 Dragon Pendulum Tuner that pops Ignis Phoenix in your other Pendulum Zone to search a second copy and summon from Deck.
Harmonizing Magician
Summons a Magician from the Deck when Pendulum Summoned from your hand.
Double Iris Magician
Level 4 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum that pairs with Harmonizing Magician.
Performapal Skullcrobat Joker
Searches Odd-Eyes Revolution Dragon, Harmonizing Magician, or Double Iris Magician on Normal Summon.
Wings of Light
Quick-Play Spell that adds Supreme King Gate Magician, Darkwurm, or Lightwurm from your Deck to your hand during the Main Phase.
Dragon Shrine
Sends Supreme King Dragon Darkwurm from your Deck to the GY so Darkwurm can revive itself and search Gate Magician without using your Normal Summon.
Pendulum Evolution
Continuous Spell that discards a Pendulum to search a 2500 ATK Pendulum and grants an extra Pendulum Summon of face-up Extra Deck Pendulums!
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Supreme King Dragon Darkwurm to the GY.
extra: Signature omni-negate Fusion boss (summoned from the Extra Deck when Odd-Eyes Absolute Dragon is sent to the GY!): bounces 1 monster on Special Summon, and shuffles 1 face-up Pendulum Monster into the Deck to negate and destroy ANY card/effect!

Rank 7 WATER Dragon Xyz (summoned using two Level 7s: Supreme King Gate Magician or Astrograph Sorcerer!): when sent to the GY, it immediately Special Summons Odd-Eyes Vortex Dragon from your Extra Deck!
Level 8 Dragon Synchro that pops a Pendulum Card to shuffle a card on the field into the Deck without targeting.
Level 8 Dragon Synchro that destroys all face-up monsters your opponent controls.
Rank 4 Dragon Xyz that searches any Pendulum Monster during the End Phase and Special Summons a Dracoslayer from your Extra Deck.
Link-2 Pendulum monster that searches Astrograph Sorcerer or any missing Scale before your Pendulum Summon and pops 2 cards on the field.

Link-3 Pendulum monster (links off Odd-Eyes Absolute Dragon to trigger Vortex Dragon!) that recovers a Pendulum from your Extra Deck and revives a Level 7 Astrograph or Gate Magician as a Quick Effect.
